translated_title: Work on the Mexico City–Guadalajara Train Begins in 2027, Sheinbaum Announces from Jalisco
original_title: Obras del tren México-Guadalajara inician en 2027, anuncia Sheinbaum desde Jalisco
author: Redacción/SinEmbargo
meta_description: After decades of abandonment, Mexico is rebuilding its passenger railway: the Mexico City–Guadalajara line breaks ground in 2027, another stretch of a national network being revived to connect most major cities.
